a: World War II in Europe ended in May 1945.
Apollo 11 landed humans on the Moon in 1969.
The public web grew rapidly in the 1990s after earlier research networks.
Writing systems emerged in several ancient civilizations independently.
The Industrial Revolution shifted economies toward machines and factories.
The printing press greatly increased the spread of written knowledge in Europe.
The Cold War was a long geopolitical rivalry after WWII without direct full-scale war between the main powers.
The United Nations was founded in 1945.
Primary sources are original materials from the time studied.
